keys: 0 = 每局随机；非 0 = 每局同一张图（复现 bug 用）。
en: 0 = random each run; non-0 = same map every run (bug repro).

keys: 1. 在 Data/language/translations.csv 加一列（表头写语言代码）；2. 在 Data/config.json 的 language.available 登记 code / name，ready 设为 true。
en: 1. Add a column to Data/language/translations.csv (header = locale code); 2. register the code / name under language.available in Data/config.json and set ready to true.

keys: AI 开销（每帧读取 · 即时生效）
WASD 与边缘滚屏共用的速度基准（像素/秒）。下次进局生效。
en: Base speed shared by WASD and edge panning (px/sec). Applies next run.

keys: 一键静音，不改上面三个滑块的值。
en: One-click mute without touching the sliders above.

keys: 一键预设（只写用户层，可随时用「恢复均衡」或底部「恢复默认」撤销）
en: One-click Preset (writes the user layer only; undo anytime via Clear Preset or Restore Defaults)

keys: 以下界面均为占位 —— 入口先占住，内容后续补
en: All pages below are placeholders — entries reserved, content comes later

keys: 低于这个连通率就换种子重新生成整张图。
en: Below this connectivity the map regenerates with a new seed.

keys:
你有 %d 处改动还没点「确认应用」。
返回会丢弃这些改动。确定返回？
en:
You have %d change(s) not applied yet.
Going back discards them. Quit anyway?

keys: 例如「首次撤离」「一局带回 100 木头」「不受伤撤离」「击杀 500 个敌人」。需要一张成就表（Data/achievements.json）+ 事件钩子（撤离、拾取、击杀、受伤）。
en: e.g. "First Extraction", "Bank 100 wood in one run", "Extract unharmed", "Kill 500 enemies". Needs an achievement table (Data/achievements.json) + event hooks (extract, loot, kill, hurt).

keys: 像素/秒；追击时还会乘倍率。
关掉后树石不再挡路（排查「卡住」时用来二分）。
en: Trees/rocks stop blocking movement (for bisecting "stuck" reports).

keys: 关掉后每棵树 / 石少画一个投影 Sprite2D，装饰密的地图能明显减负（默认开）。
en: Removes one shadow sprite per tree/rock; a clear win on dense maps (default on).

keys: 决定攻击方式与动作：剑士 = 原来的扇形挥击（战士贴图）；枪手 = 长枪突刺（枪兵 8 向贴图，射程更长）；弓 = 判定帧发射箭矢（会飞、撞墙消失、命中结算），并且强制使用弓兵贴图集。下次进局生效。
en: Attack style & animation: Swordsman = the original arc swing (warrior sprites); Lancer = spear thrust (8-dir lancer sprites, longer reach); Bow = fires real arrows on the hit frame (they fly, break on walls, resolve hits) and forces the archer sprites. Applies next run.

keys: 切换已接线：TranslationServer.set_locale；翻译表在 Data/language/translations.csv。
en: Wired up: TranslationServer.set_locale; table at Data/language/translations.csv.

keys: 制作人员 / 统计 / 成就 / 图鉴（占位）
刷日志，排查 AI/动画问题时开。
en: Verbose logging; enable when debugging AI / animation.

keys: 剑等近战武器的单次伤害。已按武器拆开 —— 原来那个全局的 combat.attack.damage 现在只是「武器表没写时才用」的兜底值，改它不再生效。
en: Per-hit damage for melee weapons. Split per weapon now — the old global combat.attack.damage is only a fallback when the weapon table is missing; changing it no longer does anything.

keys: 占屏幕高度的比例，默认 20%（= 最下面 1/5）。小地图边长随栏高自适应，HUD 的背包/血量/生存三行也会跟着让位。
en: Share of screen height, default 20% (bottom fifth). The minimap adapts; the HUD's bag/HP/survival rows shift up to make room.

keys: 只有「枪手」有真正的 8 向素材：待机/受击按朝向播不同帧，攻击也按朝向出招；其余四套是单向或仅四向，斜向与朝向差异会自动回退。画布参数（缩放/脚底偏移）已随贴图集自动切换，不用手调。当前武器是「弓」时本项无效（弓锁定弓手贴图）。下次进局生效。
en: Only "Lancer" has true 8-dir sprites: idle/hit play per facing and attacks face the target; the other four sets are single or 4-dir with auto-fallback on diagonals. Canvas params (scale / foot offset) switch with the set — no manual tuning. Ignored when the weapon is "Bow" (bow locks the archer sprites). Applies next run.

keys: 四个群系按这里的权重瓜分地图面积（相对值，不用归一；越大越占地方）。下次生成地图生效。
en: The four biomes split the map area by these relative weights (no need to normalize). Applies on map regen.

keys: 在每个 weight>0 的群系各放这么多簇。调大=该资源更多。
en: This many clusters per biome with weight>0. Higher = more of the resource.

keys: 地上可拾取资源点的占比。调高会明显增加地图负担。
en: Share of ground loot nodes. Higher = noticeably heavier map.

keys: 地图生成开销（下次生成地图生效）
地图资源成簇（树/石/铁/油）
地形出现比例（面积∝此值）
实际生命上限还要加上局外养成（雕像升级）。
en: Real max HP adds meta upgrades (statue levels).

keys:
将清空 user://settings.json 里全部自定义项，
所有参数回到 Data/config.json 的出厂值。确定吗？
en:
This clears ALL custom entries in user://settings.json;
every parameter returns to the factory values in Data/config.json. Continue?

keys: 局内最下面 1/5 那条栏：左 = 小地图（常驻）、中 = 选中单位的指令、右 = 噪音读数（当前/累积/被惊动数）。关掉后小地图与指令入口都不显示 —— 自动战斗照常跑，只是没有手动指令（指定攻击 / 巡逻 / 索敌策略）。
en: The bottom 1/5 bar in-run: left = minimap (always), middle = commands for the selected units, right = noise readout (current / accumulated / alerted). Off hides the minimap and command entries — auto combat keeps running, just without manual orders (attack / patrol / targeting).

keys: 局内界面（下次进局生效）
已见过的敌人兵种 / 中立生物 / 资源 / 地形群系，附名称与说明。配置里其实已经齐了：enemy_types.types、animal_types.types、resources.*、map.biomes 都有 name 字段。
en: Enemies / animals / resources / biomes you've seen, with names & blurbs. The config already has the data: enemy_types.types, animal_types.types, resources.*, map.biomes all carry name fields.

keys: 开一个新的存档槽，从头开始
en: Start fresh in a new save slot

keys: 开启后角色自动索敌开打：只打「观察视野 ∩ 攻击距离」内的敌人，够不着的不追、原地不动；关掉则完全不开火（只能靠走位）。
en: When on, the character auto-targets: only engages enemies inside "vision ∩ attack range" — never chases, holds position; off = never fires (movement only).

keys: 开：朝鼠标指的位置放大；关：以屏幕中心缩放。
en: On: zoom toward the mouse; off: zoom to screen center.

keys: 把 1920×1080 的设计分辨率映射到实际窗口。像素画想要锐利选「整张放大」，UI 文字要清晰选「等比放大」。改完立刻生效。
en: Maps the 1920×1080 design resolution onto the real window. "Viewport" for crisp pixels, "Canvas Items" for crisp UI text. Applies immediately.

keys: 把资源点/装饰/敌人数量与视野等一次性降到流畅档。开局明显掉帧时用；会改变本局体感，但不动出厂配置。
en: Drops loot/decor/enemy counts and vision to a smooth tier at once. Use when runs stutter; changes the feel but never touches factory config.

keys: 把这一项恢复成出厂值（点「确认应用」后生效）
en: Reset this item to the factory value (takes effect after Apply)

keys: 按窗口与地图尺寸收紧缩放下限，避免缩出一片白边。
en: Tightens the zoom floor to map/window size to avoid empty borders.

keys: 撕裂就开，输入延迟高就关。上限与「帧率上限」冲突时取较小者。
en: On if you see tearing, off for lower input lag. When both cap the rate, the lower one wins.

keys: 操作说明（当前只散在 main.gd 的注释里）、核心循环讲解（搜刮 → 撤离 → 局外养成 → 再出发）、若干张示意图。
en: Controls (currently scattered in main.gd comments), core loop walkthrough (loot → extract → meta upgrades → repeat), and a few diagrams.

keys: 改动先暂存，点右下「确认应用」才生效并保存 · 标「下次进局」的项要重新进一局才读到
en: Changes are staged; click Apply (bottom right) to save & take effect · items marked "next run" need a new run to load

keys: 攻击没有键位 —— 2026-09-17 起战斗全自动：敌人进入「观察视野 ∩ 攻击距离」就自动起手，够不着的不会追。想关掉去「玩法」页的自动战斗开关。
en: Attacks have no key binding — combat is fully automatic since 2026-09-17: enemies entering "vision ∩ attack range" are engaged automatically, never chased. Toggle Auto Combat on the "Gameplay" page to disable.

keys: 放大后倒计时/饥饿/撤离点调度都跟着加速，但玩家移动速度不变 —— 用来快速过一遍长局。
en: Speeds up countdown / hunger / extraction scheduling; player movement is unchanged — for fast-forwarding long runs.

keys: 敌人 AI 活跃半径（格）
敌人判断能否看见玩家时，沿视线每隔多远采一个墙格。越大越省、越粗糙（默认 0.35）。墙后视野判定会变松。
en: How far apart wall samples are taken along a sight line. Bigger = cheaper & coarser (default 0.35); wall checks get looser.

keys: 数据：Scripts/meta_progression.gd 的 bank / upgrade_levels 同级加 stats；界面：复制本文件的结构，把右侧详情换成图表/列表。
en: Data: add stats beside bank / upgrade_levels in Scripts/meta_progression.gd. UI: copy this file's structure and swap the detail pane for charts/lists.

keys: 数据：新建 Data/achievements.json；钩子挂在 RunManager 的结算与 enemy.gd / loot_node.gd 的事件上；存档写进槽的 stats 节点。
en: Data: create Data/achievements.json; hooks on RunManager settle and enemy.gd / loot_node.gd events; stored in the slot's stats node.

keys: 整图叠一层大尺度明暗。关掉画面更平，但能确认地形问题不是它造成的。
en: Adds a large-scale light/shadow pass over the map. Off = flatter look; useful to prove terrain issues aren't caused by it.

keys: 整图对比度/亮度/饱和度的后处理。
文案可放在 Data/help.md 或做成多页 Label；操作说明建议直接从 config 的键位读，跟「参数配置 → 操作」联动。
en: Copy can live in Data/help.md or multi-page Labels; controls should read straight from the config keys, synced with "Settings → Controls".

keys: 新建 Data/credits.md 或直接做成静态多页文本；素材来源同时记在 docs/DESIGN.md 的「缺失素材清单」章里。
en: Create Data/credits.md or a static multi-page text; asset sources are also tracked in docs/DESIGN.md under "missing assets".

keys: 无边框 = 铺满屏幕且没有标题栏。全屏/无边框下分辨率设置不生效。
en: Borderless = fills the screen without a title bar. Resolution is ignored in Fullscreen/Borderless.

keys: 更多降配项已在各页：资源点密度、敌人 / 中立数量、装饰密度在「玩法」页；宏观明暗层、画面调色、帧率上限、垂直同步在「画面」页顶部。
en: More low-spec options live on other pages: loot density, enemy / animal counts and decor density on "Gameplay"; macro light, color grading, FPS cap and V-Sync at the top of "Display".

keys: 树/石/灌木/碎石的总体倍率。

槽 %d「%s」里已有进度：
%s

覆盖后这些内容将全部丢失，确定吗？
en:
Slot %d "%s" already has progress:
%s

Overwriting loses all of it. Continue?

keys: 每支箭的伤害。敌人默认 40 生命，20 伤害 = 两箭一只。
en: Damage per arrow. Enemies have 40 HP by default: 20 damage = two arrows each.

keys: 每种资源在每个群系放「簇数」个相连簇，每簇格数 = 该群系的 weight。weight 同时决定「最小聚合格数」和「各群系之间的总量比例」（0 = 该群系不出这种）。全部下次生成地图才生效。
en: Each resource places "count" connected clusters per biome; cluster size = that biome's weight. Weight also sets the min cluster size and each biome's share (0 = none of this resource there). Everything applies on map regen.

keys: 每过这么久按 survival.supplies 逐项扣一次物资。缺哪种就按配置降哪种属性，补上立刻还原（不会把人耗死）。
en: Every this many seconds, drain supplies per survival.supplies. Missing supplies lower the matching stat and restoring them restores it (never lethal).

keys: 每隔多久重扫一次附近敌人（秒）。越小索敌越灵敏、开销越大。
en: How often nearby enemies are re-scanned (sec). Lower = more responsive but costlier.

keys: 清掉「性能优先」写下的全部用户层覆盖，回到 Data/config.json 的出厂值。
en: Removes every override written by "Performance First", back to the factory values in Data/config.json.

keys: 滚一格缩放多少。进/出互为倒数，来回滚不会漂移。下次进局生效。
en: How much each wheel notch zooms. In/out are reciprocal so it never drifts. Applies next run.

keys: 滚轮时右下角淡入的「视野 ×N」，松手 1.5 秒后自动淡出。
en: The "Zoom ×N" hint at bottom-right while scrolling; fades out 1.5s after release.

keys:
用户设置（本页改的所有值）：user://settings.json
存档槽：user://saves/slot_NN.json
旧版单槽存档：user://save.json（未删，仍被不用菜单的入口读取）
en:
User settings (everything edited here): user://settings.json
Save slots: user://saves/slot_NN.json
Legacy single save: user://save.json (kept; still read by non-menu entry points)

keys: 画面 / 音频 / 玩法 / 操作 / 语言
直接遍历 Config.get_value("enemy_types.types") 等数组生成列表；「是否见过」需要新增一个 seen 集合存进存档槽。
en: Iterate arrays like Config.get_value("enemy_types.types") to build the list; "seen" needs a new set stored in the save slot.

keys: 相对「相机平移速度」的倍率，1.0 = 与按 WASD 同速。
en: Multiplier over Camera Pan Speed; 1.0 = same speed as WASD.

keys:
确定删除槽 %d「%s」？
此操作不可撤销。
en:
Delete slot %d "%s"?
This cannot be undone.

keys: 窗口不是 16:9 时怎么补。只在「缩放模式」不是「不缩放」时有意义。
en: How to handle non-16:9 windows. Only meaningful when Scale Mode isn't "None".

keys: 累计局数、撤离成功率、死亡次数、总共拾取的各类资源、最远移动距离、平均每局时长。数据来源是 Meta 的存档槽 —— 需要给槽加一个 stats 节点，在 RunManager 结算（撤离/死亡/超时）时累加。
en: Runs, extraction success rate, deaths, resources looted by type, longest travel, average run time. Data comes from the Meta save slot — add a stats node to the slot, accumulated by RunManager on settle (extract / death / timeout).

keys: 给无头回归用的。注意：从菜单点进游戏时会被临时压掉（菜单要落在基地），所以在菜单里改这项不影响菜单启动。
en: For headless regression. Note: temporarily suppressed when launching from the menu (the menu must land at the base).

keys: 缩到最远时的倍数（0.35 ≈ 视野宽 2.9 倍）。实际下限还会按地图/窗口尺寸收敛，保证整张地图能装下。
en: Zoom-out limit (0.35 ≈ 2.9× wider view). The actual floor adapts to map/window size so the whole map fits.

keys: 美术资源署名。注意这份清单是「许可合规」的一部分，不能省：Tiny Swords (Free Pack) — Pixel Frog，CC0。后续每引入一份 CC0/CC-BY 素材都要登记。
en: Art asset attribution. This list is a license-compliance must: Tiny Swords (Free Pack) — Pixel Frog, CC0. Register every new CC0/CC-BY asset here.

keys: 能看见多远。实际攻击距离取「武器射程与观察视野的较小值」，所以调小它等于同时削所有武器的射程；设计上应大于攻击距离。
en: How far you can see. Effective range = min(weapon range, vision), so lowering this nerfs every weapon; keep it above attack range.

keys: 菜单界面语言切换：中文 / English，与「参数配置 → 语言」共用同一个配置键。
en: Menu interface language: Chinese / English, sharing the same config key as "Settings → Language".

keys: 视野与迷雾（下次进局生效）
语言切换本身已经能用，在「参数配置 → 语言」里，但目前只是存值、没有翻译表，选了不会改变界面文字。
en: Language switching works via "Settings → Language"; the whole menu UI switches between Chinese and English on Apply.

keys: 语言已接入 i18n：菜单与各面板支持简体中文 / English，下拉选择后点「确认应用」整体切换。
en: i18n is wired up: the menu and its panels support Simplified Chinese / English. Pick one and click Apply to switch.

keys: 读取已有存档继续游戏
调试项：影响的是开发期行为，不是游戏平衡。发布前建议恢复默认。
en: Debug items: dev-time behavior only, no game balance. Restore defaults before shipping.

keys: 资源 %d 种 / 共 %d · 升级 %d 级
超出此半径的敌人休眠，不跑状态机与视线检测 —— 地图大、敌人多时最省 CPU 的一档（默认 32）。调小远处敌人反应会变迟钝。
en: Enemies beyond this radius sleep (no state machine / LOS checks). The biggest CPU saver on big, crowded maps (default 32). Lower = slower faraway reactions.

keys: 越大越跟手；0 = 滚一档立刻到位。
距窗口边缘多少像素内算「贴边」。开画面缩放时视口恒为 1920×1080，24 ≈ 短边 2.2%。
en: How close to the edge counts as "at the edge". With scaling on, the viewport is always 1920×1080; 24 ≈ 2.2% of the short side.

keys: 这一页全部是「下次进局」才读到的键 —— 改完请重新进一局。
en: Every key on this page is read at the start of a run — start a new run after changing.

keys: 这一页是「降配提速」的开关。生效时机各不同：AI 活跃半径、视线步长每帧读取，改完下一帧即见效；视野半径、资源点/装饰/敌人数量、投影、明暗调色要在设置里改完后重新进一局 / 重新生成地图才读到。
en: "Lower specs, more speed" switches. Timing varies: AI radius & LOS step are read every frame (instant); vision radius, loot/decor/enemy counts, shadows, lighting & grading need a new run / map regen.

keys: 迷雾揭示半径，也是敌人 / 资源点的可见范围。每帧揭示面积随半径平方增长，调小可减负，但缩短可视距离（默认 10，硬核向不建议太小）。
en: Fog reveal radius; also how far enemies / loot can be spotted. Revealed area grows with r², so lower = cheaper but shorter sight (default 10; not recommended too small for hardcore play).

keys: 选择一个存档继续游戏
选择一个空槽存档；已有存档会被覆盖（会二次确认）
en: Pick an empty slot to save; existing saves get overwritten (with confirmation)
Wild goats; kill them for food.

keys: 键位一律用「物理键码」记录（与游戏内消费端一致），所以非 QWERTY 键盘也不会错位。点按钮后按任意键即可改；ESC 取消。
en: Keys are stored as physical keycodes (same as the game reads), so non-QWERTY layouts never desync. Click a button then press any key; ESC cancels.

keys: 项目目前还没有接入音频资源，这几项属于提前把线接好：改动会即时作用到对应的 AudioBus（Music / SFX 总线不存在时自动创建）。
en: No audio assets are wired up yet; these pre-wire the buses. Changes apply instantly to their AudioBus (Music / SFX buses are created if missing).

keys: 风格化（下次生成地图生效）
默认「不限」。笔记本想降温省电选 60。改成下拉是为了不再出现「拖到 1 帧把游戏卡死」的情况。上限与垂直同步冲突时取较小者。
en: Default "Uncapped". Pick 60 on laptops to stay cool. It's a dropdown so you can no longer drag it to 1 FPS and freeze the game. When both cap the rate, the lower one wins.

keys: 鼠标停在按钮/面板上时不滚，避免点界面顺手把画面带走。
en: No scrolling while the cursor hovers buttons/panels.

keys: 鼠标贴到窗口边，画面就往那个方向滚（RTS 手感）。窗口失去焦点时不滚。
en: Push the mouse against the window edge to scroll (RTS feel). Off while the window is unfocused.

keys: 开发版 · Tiny Swords 2D 线
ESC 返回上一级 · 设置改动即时保存到 user://settings.json
en: ESC back · settings save instantly to user://settings.json

keys: 确认应用后界面文字整体切换；数据存进 user://settings.json。
en: Click Apply to switch the whole UI; the choice is stored in user://settings.json.
